publication: INTERNAL AUDIT ARTIFACT — do not serve, do not bundle. It carries evidence for SUPPRESSED cells on purpose: a suppression that cannot be audited cannot be trusted. It contains no merchant id, name, street or address; its only merchant-attributable figure is the aggregate top-1 share. The app reads the GATED artifacts/aggregate.json, never this file.

method.card_count: count(DISTINCT pymt_crd_acct_num_raw) over the cell's union relation (never a sum of children: a card pays in several postcodes)
method.merchant_partition: count(*) GROUP BY mrch_nm_raw; sums to n_transactions by construction
method.top1_share: exact Fraction: max(per-merchant transactions) / n_transactions; the gate compares exact rationals, the printed percentage is rounded after
method.residual_n_cards: n_cards − |{cards whose every transaction in this cell is with that one merchant}| — the MEASURED leave-one-out union count G4 uses
method.postcode_universe: every distinct merchant_postal_code_normalized value: 54 Sopot '81-*' codes plus 7 out-of-town codes carried by Sopot-labelled merchants = 62; the no-postcode bucket is excluded and counted below
method.daypart: local Europe/Warsaw time: night 00–05, morning 06–11, afternoon 12–17, evening 18–23; month = the LOCAL calendar month

excluded_rows.reason: defect D2: tran_id_gmt_tm='000000' is not a transaction time; excluded from the daypart grain and counted here
excluded_rows.month_axis_note: the daypart grain uses the LOCAL calendar month; 152 row(s) sit in a different local month than prch_mnth_id, so the axis has 19 months instead of 18

sensitivity_local_month_vs_prch_mnth_id.note: the month axis re-derived from prch_mnth_id instead of the local calendar month

matches_expected.compared: the VOLUME-ONLY reading of G3 — the one the audit tables measured

findings.statement: The contract evaluates G3 on BOTH metrics and fails the cell if either exceeds the limit (compliance §2.3 R7, required by reference fixture F-11). The audit tables measured the volume metric only, so the conservative reading suppresses 1 further postcode cell(s) and the 18/90.7% figure becomes 17/89.95%.

cells.verdict: released on the volume metric; suppressed on the card metric

findings.statement: G4 (leave-one-out differencing, a voluntary strengthening beyond the letter of the rule) is evaluated on MEASURED residuals at both grains. Its de-facto effect is a 4-merchant floor: with three merchants, removing any one leaves two and the residual fails G2 by construction.
